Applied quality-checks.md s.51 procedure to frozen .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r10/task (Python 3.12.10 tomllib, bash -n, node v24.19.0 --check, all in memory; no files written to the workspace).

Criterion counts 1/1/43/5/5; ids unique per file; every type is binary|likert (visual likert points=5); weights positive; descriptions non-empty. [judge] keys are identical to the frozen template (judge=claude-code, mode=batched, timeout, isolated=false, prompt_template=prompt.md); no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight. mcp_servers equal the template's server for server, including the functional verifier restart server. Timeouts 600/600/9000/900/900 equal the template's. Gate budget 1500 + scored budget 11100 (test.sh:213,224) <= [verifier].timeout_sec 13200 (task.toml:27). Every prompt.md contains {criteria} and {app_context}.
Shell: bash -n passes for solution/solve.sh and tests/test.sh, and both start with #!/bin/bash. A whole-tree byte scan found no CR in any file, no BOM, no non-UTF-8 file and no file missing its final newline. tests/test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/.dockerignore, environment/Dockerfile and tests/scoring.toml are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff -q). score.py and restart_mcp.py pass ast.parse (in memory, no bytecode).
JSON: environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution/app/src/seed_data.json (byte-identical, sha256 a1c65c80...) and solution/app/package.json parse. package.json is commonjs, main server.js, with deps express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1; the environment Dockerfile installs both globally with NODE_PATH set.
Reference entry: solution/app/server.js:2 is require('./src/index.js'). node --check passes for server.js, src/{index,bootstrap,db}.js and public/js/{app,board,threads}.js. Every require resolves to node builtins, express, better-sqlite3 or local files that exist. index.html references /styles.css and /js/{board,threads,app}.js, and all of them exist. db.js:10 loads the seed beside it.
Would run: raw-evidence-index.json input_sha256 matches the assignment. All 6 artifact hashes verify, and all 12 matching_source_files hashes equal the frozen solution bytes. qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json records 25/25 groups passed with page_errors=[], including 'restart keeps jobs... without reseeding'. server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice, which is consistent with a real restart. workspace.cjs:16 launches node /app/server.js with a sanitized env (PORT 3000, DB_PATH, NODE_PATH).
Adversarial: a submission with a broken server.js does not affect this row, which covers the task's own files; test.sh's liveness probe and zero reward handle it. A conforming alternative such as an ESM entry or a different file layout is not blocked by any task file here, because the gating files only launch /app/server.js.
Risk reason: this is a measurement gap, not a defect. The index scope says full configured grading is absent, so neither the verifier image build nor a RewardKit 0.1.7 load of these judge.toml files was measured this round. solve.sh is not shown being invoked by the scripted run, whose install step is not recorded in workspace.cjs. The parse-level checks for this row are fully clean.
